question: Will the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season reach at least 6 named storms by October 3, 2026?

calls.reasoning: The resolution source (NHC TCR index 2026 season summary) already shows 'Named Storms: 6' as of Sep 23, 2026, with Fay (TS, Sep 19-23) listed. Multiple outlets (AccuWeather, Fox Weather, Click2Houston, Fox13) confirm Fay became the 6th named storm on Sep 20. NO needs the NHC to strike Fay from the count before Oct 3. Post-season reanalysis happens months later and only rarely removes a storm. The 1% residual covers a page error or a misread. No matching human market exists: the Polymarket and Manifold contracts price hurricane counts, not named storms.
calls.dossier:
- NHC TCR index page (fetched 2026-09-23): the 2026 season summary table reads 'Named Storms: 6', 0 hurricanes, 0 major. Storms listed: Arthur (Jun 17-18), Bertha (Jul 19-23), Cristobal (Aug 12-13), Dolly (Aug 27-28), Edouard (Aug 31-Sep 2), Fay (TS, Sep 19-23, marked active at last update).
- AccuWeather, Fox Weather, Click2Houston (Sep 21), Fox13 and Spectrum News 13 (Sep 20): Tropical Depression Six was upgraded to TS Fay early Sunday, Sep 20, 2026, near the Azores; it peaked around 70 mph and was forecast to dissipate Tuesday, Sep 22.
- Breaking Belize News and Quadratin (Sep 22-23): six named storms, no hurricanes; the latest hurricane-free date since 1914; strong El Nino.
- Status quo: the count on the resolution page is already at the threshold. A NO requires the NHC to remove Fay before Oct 3.
- Base rate: NHC operational named storms are removed only in post-season Tropical Cyclone Reports or reanalysis, which normally come months after the season. I found no case of removal within two weeks.
- Resolves off: the NHC TCR index 2026 summary 'Named Storms' count, not hurricane counts or media reports.
- Event window: season start -> 2026-10-03 23:59 UTC; as of Sep 23, about 10 days remain. The threshold was already met on Sep 20.
- Markets: Polymarket and Manifold contracts only cover hurricane counts; no market on the named-storm count was found.
- Searched for any NHC statement downgrading or reclassifying Fay: none found.
calls.reference_class: Questions whose threshold has already been met on the named resolution source with ~10 days left; named storms removed from the NHC tally within weeks of naming
